priority: P1 — validate the 30-minute TagDuel decision timeout, opposing-team walkover, persisted public transition event, lock release and rejection of stale actions.

behavior: A playing TagDuel remains active one millisecond before DECISION_TIMEOUT_MS and finishes exactly at the 30-minute boundary.
Timeout produces a W.O. winner for the team opposite decisionPlayer, records the reason and persists a public duelFinished transition event at the new revision.
All four tag_members locks are released, currentTag is cleared, LP and canonical physical UIDs remain unchanged, and the finished public board is queued until markTagPublished.
A stale action menu from the active physical representative is rejected after timeout without a second revision or card mutation.
implementation.validation: Four-human classic-loan lobby accepted through handleTagComponent; temporary SQLite; tagPrivateMessage/tagPublicMessage; validateDiscordPayload; getTag(id, now); tagEventsAt; dueTags; markTagPublished; canonical tagInventory.

limitations: Discord handlers and payload builders run offline; no live guild, bot token or Discord API call.
Temporary SQLite/player fixtures only; no persistent player, deck, collection or production state is changed.
Test/evidence/workflow only; no runtime, card resolver, catalogue, certification or allowlist changes.

synchronization.method: merge commit with shared branch as first parent and previous M471 HEAD as second parent; force-with-lease expected the previous branch SHA
